Vendor Access Requests. If Licensee requires a manufacturing subcontractor or cloud processing vendor to access the Licensed Technology solely to perform services for Licensee's benefit, Licensee may submit a written request identifying the proposed vendor and the scope of access requested. Calloway will consider each request in good faith but is not obligated to approve any vendor, and any approval Calloway grants is limited to the specific vendor and specific scope identified in that request. Before receiving any access, an approved vendor must execute a written agreement, in a form acceptable to Calloway, containing confidentiality and use restrictions at least as protective as those set forth in this Agreement

Vendor Access Requests. If Licensee requires a manufacturing subcontractor or cloud processing vendor to access the Licensed Technology solely to perform services for Licensee's benefit, Licensee may submit a written request identifying the proposed vendor and the scope of access requested. Calloway will consider each request in good faith and will respond to Licensee in writing within twenty (20) business days, but is not obligated to approve any vendor, and any approval Calloway grants is limited to the specific vendor and specific scope identified in that request. Before receiving any access, an approved vendor must execute a written agreement, in a form acceptable to Calloway, containing confidentiality and use restrictions at least as protective as those set forth in this Agreement.

Segregation Right. If Calloway reasonably determines that performing a Work Order using its standard equipment or personnel would create a conflict with Calloway's federal grant obligations or export control obligations, Calloway may perform the affected Work Order using segregated equipment, restricted access facilities, or alternative personnel, and any resulting delay is not a breach of Calloway's obligations under this Agreement

, provided that (i) Calloway will notify Client at Work Order acceptance if segregation is anticipated, (ii) if segregation delays completion by more than thirty (30) days beyond the Committed Turnaround, Client may terminate the affected Work Order and receive a refund of fees paid for Certification Services not performed, and (iii) Calloway bears the costs of segregation.

Tenant shall have three (3) successive options to renew this Lease, each for an additional term of five (5) years (each, a “Renewal Term,” and together with the Initial Term, the “Term”), on the same terms and conditions set forth in this Lease except for Base Rent, which shall be determined in accordance with Section 2 of Article IV. Tenant shall exercise each renewal option, if at all, by written notice to Landlord given not less than one hundred eighty (180) days prior to the expiration of the Initial Term or the then-current Renewal Term, as applicable.
